description: Read the full contents of a file from a knowledge base, including a content_sha256 hash of the returned text for use as an edit_file precondition.
embedding_description: Open, read, view, or fetch the full text contents of a single named file — typically a markdown (.md) document — inside a knowledge base, together with its metadata and a content_sha256 hash of the exact returned text. Read-only; it does not list directories or modify anything. Use when you already know a file's path and want to see what that one file contains, or to obtain the content hash before a hash-preconditioned edit_file. This is the way to read a workbench planning document after discovering it: pass the Read path from the discovery chunk as the path, with name workbench. The returned content_sha256 is the value to pass back as edit_file's expected_content_hash.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFoundError: file not found. PathTraversalError: path escapes KB root.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Use browse to verify the file path.
